{{Quote|And now, my dear friend Leia Organa Solo tells me about her discovery that Padmé was her mother, and of what became of Anakin. My head is still reeling. I've known Leia ever since we both served in the Imperial Senate, and to think that neither of us ever had the slightest inkling that we were first cousins.|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Pooja Naberrie''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] and revolutionary leader who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the younger daughter of [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Darred Janren Naberrie]], the younger sister of [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo Naberrie]], and niece of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], making Pooja the first cousin of twins [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Sharing the same ideals as her aunt, Pooja followed her example by entering politics some time after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She eventually served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Naboo in the Imperial Senate and became a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]]. However after the Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|disbanded]], she returned to Naboo and [[Naboo Resistance (Galactic Civil War)|resisted]] the Empire on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I was just a little girl, only four years old, when I first saw Anakin. Oh, my. I thought he was the most handsome man I’d ever seen, and so tall! My memory of him is entirely from a child’s perspective, and I still envision him as a giant.|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />}}
Pooja Naberrie was born in the [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]], a prominent family from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the younger daughter of [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Darred Janren Naberrie]]. Similarly to her sister [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]], who was named after their [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] [[Ryoo Thule|maternal grandmother]], Pooja received the name of her father's [[Pooja|maternal grandmother]].<ref name="FF105">{{FactFile|105|NAB 7-8|Sola Naberrie}}</ref>

[[File:RyooPadmePoojaAnakinR2D2-AOTC.jpg|thumb|left|280px|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] introduces [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Pooja and [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo Naberrie]] in the first days of the Clone Wars]]
Pooja spent her childhood with her parents and sister, living in the [[Naberrie family home|family home]] in the Naboo [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="FF84">{{FactFile|84|NAB 33-36|Naboo &ndash; Naberrie Family Home}}</ref> As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], she was considered to be very talkative and like many other young children, she seemed to have a new idea for what she wanted to be when she grew up every [[Standard week/Legends|week]] and often spoke of being a senator, a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a [[tusk cat]] trainer, and even an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="FF105" /> It is said that she, like her sister, had a crush on [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the future [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|husband]] of their aunt [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], when he visited the family during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She also liked playing games with him and asked a lot of questions.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />

[[File:Pooja_funeral.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Seven-year-old Pooja attended her aunt's funeral in the first days of the Empire.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Amidala had been compelled to miss Pooja's fifth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] celebrations because of her work in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. She had sent a gift to Pooja and commed her beloved niece on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]], but she still felt guilty for not being able to be there in person.<ref name="Gambit-Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>

Two years later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Pooja, along with the rest of the Naberrie family and thousands of other mourners, attended her aunt Padmé Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] shortly after the Clone Wars ended.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Like the rest of the family, she ignored that Padmé had been killed by Anakin Skywalker when he became Darth Vader. Moreover, the family was not aware that Amidala gave birth to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />

===Rebel senator===
{{Quote|Welcome. I'm Pooja Naberrie, a Senator of the Old Republic and leader of the Naboo Resistance against the Empire. We are pressed hard, but we fight hard.|Pooja Naberrie, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SPN" />}}
Years later, some time after the [[Declaration of a New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Pooja Naberrie entered the world of politics. She was eventually appointed representative of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> replacing the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="FF55">{{FactFile2014|55|JAR 11-16|Jar Jar Binks}}</ref> Like her aunt,<ref name="RotS" /> she held the position of senator.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> This made her a colleague of her cousin, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the senator of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and the two became good friends, completely unaware of their familial relationship.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" /> In order to ensure Senator Naberrie's security, a woman named [[Kima Nazith]] served as Pooja's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].<ref name="SWG:KN">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kima Nazith|Naboo}}</ref> Pooja Naberrie would hold her position until the Imperial Senate's [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]]<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Her official duties were then taken over by [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], the newly appointed [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="FF34">{{FactFile2014|34|PAN 5-6|Captain Panaka}}</ref> The ex-senator later returned to her homeworld where she continued to play a role in Naboo politics by acting as a gray eminence.<ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

[[File:Senator_Pooja_Naberrie.jpg|thumb|220px|left|Pooja Naberrie in Dee'ja Peak during the Galactic Civil War]]
During her senatorial career, Pooja Naberrie became a Rebel sympathizer. Thus, she chose armed resistance against the Empire during the Galactic Civil War and became the leader of the [[Naboo Resistance (Galactic Civil War)|Naboo Resistance]] by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> Her bodyguard Kima Nazith served as her most trusted advisor in the Resistance.<ref name="SWG:KN" /> At some point, the Naboo Resistance get associated with the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Imperial [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] suspected that Pooja Naberrie could be connected to the Naboo Resistance. This forced the former senator and Kima Nazith to go into hiding for some times in [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]], an isolated city in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:KN" /> While there, Naberrie did not remain inactive. She organized a conclave of Naboo [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] sympathetic to the Resistance in order to convince them to join the rebellion in a more active manner. The meeting was also supported by the Rebel Alliance that sent to Naboo the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Herosk Bal'far]], an aide to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and hero of the Rebellion, as a guest of honor; as well as several Rebel operatives to help with the organization. However, the conference was compromised by the Empire even before it started because of a series of unfortunate events. The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Gizda Ramani]] was shot down the Empire while carrying information about the meeting between the Naboo Resistance and the Rebel Alliance. Herosk Bal'far was identified and wanted by Imperial forces upon arriving on Naboo. [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Turon Adala]] who was in charge of the security of the conference was injured in a firefight with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in patrol. Finally, [[Lim Paddu]], the Naboo noble the most devoted to the Resistance, was captured by Imperial troops during a random identity check. Thankfully for Naberrie, the Rebel Alliance operatives were able to successfully rescue all these individuals alive, and before the Empire could obtain information from them.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> In the meantime, Kima Nazith prevented the attempts of Inquisitor Sikander to localize the senator. Nazith and a group of Rebel Alliance operatives assassinated a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] informant named [[Benbul Leedee]] before he could provide information to the Inquisitor. They also eliminated the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Hrodius Goragg]] who had been paid by Sikander to find the senator. Eventually, the Rebel operatives fought and killed the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Kunn Kuroosh]], a presumed [[Sith sorcerer]], who was investigating Dee'ja Peak.<ref name="SWG:KN" /> In the end, the conclave of Naboo aristocrats finally started near Dee'ja Peak. Although everything seemed to be going well, Senator Naberrie discovered during the meeting that the servant of one of the conference participants, [[Melloc Fitzal]], was in fact a covert agent for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. However, the man managed to leave the meeting undetected before the Rebels realized he was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. The group of Rebel operatives immediately went after the spy but they were too late to prevent him to join a group of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] in the Naboo wilderness. During the ensuring fight, the Rebel strike team was able to kill Fitzal and his escort. Meanwhile, the conference ended without further trouble. The Rebel operatives returned to Pooja Naberrie in Dee'ja Peak who was happy to inform them that all participants returned from the meeting safely.<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

===Helping the RSF===
{{Quote|Good, you're here. Colonel Panaka told me to expect you after you finished assisting Typho. There are two assignments for you. [...] The first is to help investigate a terrorist attack that just took place here in Theed. The second is a bit more personal and I'd like to keep it a bit quiet if possible. A friend, Hugo Eckener, has a dilemma with which he needs assistance.|Pooja Naberrie, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtPN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to Pooja Naberrie|Naboo}}</ref>}}
[[File:Pooja_in_Theed.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Pooja Naberrie working in the Theed Royal Palace]]
Later the same year, Pooja Naberrie's situation returned to normal so the former senator finally returned to Theed. There, she worked from the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] in helping the Royal Naboo Security Forces.<ref name="SWG:RtPN" /> The same year, she recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had previously worked for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] among the RSF. She first tasked them to help [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]] during a [[terrorist attack in Theed]].<ref name="SWG:HwtAotTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help with the Aftermath of the Terrorist Attack|Naboo}}</ref> This finally led to the RSF [[raid on the Mummer bunker]].<ref name="SWG:BTttT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring Terror to the Terrorists|Naboo}}</ref> Naberrie also requested the RSF agents to help [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]] whose son had been kidnapped. The agents [[Rescue of Karl Eckener|rescued]] [[Karl Eckener]] who was held captive in the [[Darkwalker Cave (Theed)|Darkwalker Cave]].<ref name="SWG:RKE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Karl Eckener|Naboo}}</ref> Eventually, Pooja Naberrie tasked the RSF agents to assist [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]] in hunting the escaped murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]].<ref name="SWG:CtEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Catch the Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref> Eventually, Pooja Naberrie granted high security clearance to the spacers and gave them access to the RSF mainframe. The spacers then used the RSF database to find clues about the location of an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was wanted by both the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:RSFM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|RSF Mainframe|Naboo}}</ref>

===Later life===
{{Quote|If Leia hadn’t told me herself, I don’t think I ever would have believed that Anakin Skywalker became Darth Vader. It’s just so &hellip; so entirely inconceivable that that lovely young man could have become Vader. And yet that’s exactly what happened, isn’t it? To think I held his hand. His good hand. Oh, my.|Pooja Naberrie|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />}}
Around [[36 ABY]], Leia Organa met with Pooja Naberrie and told her about her discovery that Padmé was her mother and that the two of them were first cousins. Pooja subsequently recounted to Leia her recollections of Anakin Skywalker. This encounter was later narrated in the book ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Pooja Naberrie first appeared in a deleted scene of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. She was portrayed by [[Hayley Mooy]] in ''Attack of the Clones'', as well as in a brief scene of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/news20030829.html|text=Episode III Casting: Mother & Daughters}}</ref>

===''Star Wars Galaxies''===
Pooja Naberrie also appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Senator Pooja Naberrie could originally be found in the city of Dee'ja Peak where she proposed six quests to Rebel players. During these missions, the player had to help Pooja and the Naboo Resistance.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> However, these quests were known to be extensively bugged and very difficult to complete.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref> Moreover, Pooja Naberrie declared at some point that she was a senator of the Old Republic.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> This claim was made impossible by {{Film|III}}, released after the game, that depicted her as a young child at the moment of the fall of the Republic.<ref name="RotS" /> Later sources, such as ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', 
later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] she was in fact a senator of the Imperial Senate.<ref name="TCSWE" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> the character of "Senator Pooja Naberrie" in Dee'ja Peak was removed from the game while another character, only identified as "Pooja Naberrie" was added near the Theed Royal Palace.<ref name="SWG:RtPN" /> The new missions proposed by Pooja were part of the Naboo branch of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest quest chain in the game. These quests did not provide any information about Pooja Naberrie herself and did not mention neither her position as a senator nor her role in the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:RtPN" /><ref name="SWG:RSFM" />
